svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: iOS · Settings · PicPlace · Disconnect this library (confirm with the numbers) · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors PicPlaceSettingsCard's Disconnect this library… confirmationDialog (App/PicPlace/PicPlaceViews.swift) over PicPlaceController.disconnectMessage / disconnectSummary — libraries plan L23, step 0 (2026-09-17; the Mac's confirm, on the Libraries row, carries the same text and is verified against the Mac bench). The message says the numbers: 'The library stops syncing and forgets its account and what it has synced. 877 previews pulled from PicPlace stay on this iPhone but cannot download until you connect it again. 3 projects with originals here stay as they are. Nothing changes on PicPlace. Switching libraries never needs this.' Disconnect (destructive) removes the binding and the sync records and nothing else — the previews stay (a later link to the same library finds them in step, no download; a link elsewhere removes them, and says so on the sheet); Cancel.
